title: Depth or Description? When a One-Step Latent Score Replaces Lookahead in Proactive Information Acquisition
abstract: arXiv:2611.07155v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A proactive agent must decide what to ask before it acts. Exact lookahead values combinations of questions but is expensive and leans on a fitted model; a one-step score is cheap but can miss them. Our main finding: the need for depth often lies in how the hidden cause is described. A one-step score on the label can be blind to an interaction among answers. A score on a suitable latent cause is not, and where that latent encodes the decision it replaces most of depth at a fraction of the search. Described differently, the same problem can defeat the score while exact values do not move, so keep the latent small and check it against exact values. Probabilities learned from one language model's answers do not carry to another unless planning allows for both; those read from tokens are worth only a few labels.

translated_title: 深度还是描述？在主动信息获取中，一步式潜在评分何时能替代前瞻搜索
translated_abstract: 主动式智能体必须在行动之前决定询问什么。精确的前瞻搜索能评估问题的各种组合，但代价高昂且依赖于拟合的模型；一步式评分虽然廉价，却可能遗漏这些组合效应。我们的主要发现是：对搜索深度的需求往往取决于隐藏原因的描述方式。基于标签的一步式评分可能无法察觉答案之间的相互作用，而基于合适潜在原因的评分则不会；当该潜在变量编码了决策信息时，它能以极小的搜索代价替代大部分深度前瞻搜索。换一种描述方式，同一个问题可能会使评分失效，而精确值却不受影响，因此应保持潜在变量足够小，并用精确值加以对照验证。从一个语言模型的回答中学习到的概率无法迁移到另一个语言模型，除非规划过程能兼容两者；而直接从token中读取的概率仅相当于几个标签的价值。
tldr: 该论文发现主动信息获取中对深度前瞻搜索的需求往往源于隐藏原因的描述方式——基于能编码决策信息的合适潜在变量构建的一步式评分，可以用极小的搜索代价替代大部分深度前瞻搜索。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that the need for lookahead depth in proactive information acquisition often lies in how the hidden cause is described—a one-step score over a suitable latent cause that encodes the decision can replace most of the depth search at a fraction of the cost.
